blocks.text: Let’s be honest, my dear readers: The Street Fighter franchise has had a seriously volatile, roller-coaster history on the silver screen. Ever since that infamous 1994 Jean-Claude Van Damme vehicle—which, let’s face it, has since achieved a legendary, ironic cult status—and that completely forgettable 2009 attempt focusing on Chun-Li, we fans have learned to keep our expectations tightly checked. For decades, it felt like a franchise completely unable to translate its massive arcade and console dominance into anything resembling cinematic coherence. But hold onto your seats, because with the arrival of ‘Street Fighter’ (2026), the curse has officially been broken! SONIC BOOM! What we get here […]...
